name: Samson Cobb
role: one of the Banked (Blood Hunter 2, Pale Moon; Owl at level 3)
backstory: A giff Watchman quenched from Frenzy on day 3, Samson kept watch over the forge on the night of day 3 and helped walk the agitator Ashlo to Halda's cells. On day 10 he set out for Dunmarrow with Hesby Bramble by the north shore.
secrets: He is one of the Banked.
dm_only: No relation to the Ashward Cobbs is recorded.
